C9000311.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 311 (The Hovey–Strickland and Chai conjectures.; papers: Stabilizer orbits and thick tensor ideals of dualizable K(n)-local spectra; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

MS311_HS.statement: For every prime and height, the dualizable K(n)-local thick tensor ideals form the n+2-member chromatic chain (thm:main).

MS311_PRIMES.statement: Every proper open-stabilizer-invariant prime of E_0 is 0 or a height ideal (fin:primes).

MS311_SUPPORT.statement: The all-prime support comparison reduces the dualizable spectral classification to stabilizer-invariant radical ideals (fin:support; BHN Theorem 4.9). This input is not audited in this mission.

MS311_PRIME_AUX.statement: Curve detection, nonzero translated analytic germs, and characteristic-zero orbit density supply the remaining hypotheses of the invariant-prime argument. These are not audited in this mission.

MS311_ORBITS.statement: At every positive-characteristic height-h point, a local analytic equation vanishing on a sufficiently close open-stabilizer orbit is zero (orb:density).

MS311_FORMAL.statement: A nonzero residue-field formal equation on a subgroup of a Honda-group product yields a common nonzero endomorphism annihilator (formal:closure); Frobenius separation preserves its quantifiers. This is not audited in this mission.

MS311_BUNDLES.statement: A nonzero natural Honda-cover morphism gives an endomorphism orbit on independent vectors with no nonzero residue-field formal equation (bundles:nondegeneracy). This is not audited in this mission.

MS311_ORBIT_AUX.statement: Integral comparison maps, stabilizer compatibility, and the finite analytic jet estimates supply the remaining inputs to orb:density. These are not audited in this mission.

C_TATE9000311.statement: For every prime p, every 1<=h<n, every small height-h point x, and every etale Tate basis, D(theta)_x=M with the stated parameter derivatives and det(M)!=0.

L_TATE_ANALYTIC9000311.statement: Tate-algebra convergence justifies the chain rule, and P_x'(T)=0 gives the exact Jacobian identity D(theta)_x=M.

L_TATE_TRANSPORT9000311.statement: The contraction limit defines an analytic specialization, identifies the Honda cover with the inverse limit of H_y under [p], and identifies T_x/pT_x with G_x^et[p](C).

L_TATE_ALGEBRAIC9000311.statement: Prepared finite kernels algebraize to a height-n p-divisible group; at x its connected height is h and its etale height is r. Analytic p-torsion equations give genuine points of the prepared finite group scheme.

L_TATE_SPLIT9000311.statement: Over a perfect-field square-zero Artin thickening, lifting an etale p-torsion basis splits the etale quotient by Frobenius-Verschiebung descent, with the original residue marking.

L_TATE_HEIGHT9000311.statement: Factorization of a marked height-h deformation's p-series through T^(p^h) makes that deformation constant.

L_TATE_KS9000311.statement: The full parameter Kodaira-Spencer map is an R_0-module isomorphism whose arbitrary-map specialization classifies the given first-order analytic parameter deformation.

L_TATE_RANK9000311.statement: A full injective comparison and zero connected restriction force the square etale restriction to have nonzero determinant; the etale restriction's rank is not assumed.
